blocks.md: An operator tells the warehouse mobile manipulator to "pick the red mug" from an active takeaway conveyor. The request names an outcome and leaves the grasp pose, approach velocity, contact force, and execution deadline unspecified. Spatial memory has already done its part by recording a belief about the mug's handle with an evidence epoch, an initial error of …, and a growth law. Under that law, the moving belt carries the handle outside the … grasp tolerance … after capture.

questions.q: The section **Grounded Affordances** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Metric precision does not establish identity, so a confident wrong object yields a collision-free, torque-limited proposal that passes every check the safety MCU can make, and semantic errors need their own defense.
An intent handoff must keep spatial containment, temporal freshness, dynamic effort, and a certified fallback, and the admission gates check them in cost order.

The permission side grants a target, never a path, as a lease binding goal set, affordance frame, predicates, ceilings, and an MCU-selected fallback to a hardware deadline at the earliest of the evidence horizon, the administrative lease, and the stopping deadline.
